description: This file contains the implementation of an AWS Token class, which manages AWS security tokens, including methods for serialization, expiration checks, and state management.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A basic implementation of an AWS security token, capable of serialization and expiration handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the token with a security token string and optional expiration timestamp.

methods.name: __set_state
methods.description: Restores an instance from a stored state array.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on current time.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the token data as an array.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON string.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores object state from serialized JSON data.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Provides an array representation of the object for serialization.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Reinitializes the object from an array of data.
